endorsements.quote: Standardizing data and validating models across multiple centers is essential to ensuring clinical applicability.

Ethical and legal considerations associated with AI limit broad application and reproducibility, and regulatory compliance is crucial to safeguarding patient outcomes as AI becomes more prevalent in healthcare.

unlisted_practices: Standardize MRI imaging protocols across scanners and institutions to minimize variability affecting radiomics model reproducibility.
Use explainable AI methods such as Shapley additive explanations or LIME so clinicians can identify influential features and verify AI reliability.
Enroll diverse populations and standardize demographic data collection in clinical studies of AI devices to ensure equitable performance.

screen.reason: This is a letter/commentary discussing an external study on an MRI radiomics prediction model, commenting on bias mitigation, generalizability, and regulatory compliance considerations.
